answer: Best chain on garnet (calibration set f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade): QB11-QB12-QB7, with QB12 in the middle. The IRB CZ fidelities are QB12-QB11 = 0.998693 and QB12-QB7 = 0.998016, so the product is about 0.996712. I ran a GHZ circuit on garnet:mock with 200 shots. It was H on QB12, then CZ on QB12-QB11 and QB12-QB7, then a measurement of all three. The transpiled circuit used only those two CZ gates. Qiskit bit order is c2c1c0, which is QB7, QB12, QB11. Counts: 111=60, 001=49, 000=46, 110=45. The mock returns noisy, near-random results, so the counts do not show a clean GHZ state. No billed seconds were requested. I did not use the real QPU.
